notes: Read SKILL.md (56 lines) in full; it is the only file. Educational overview of PE/ELF structure, decompilation theory, buffer-overflow mechanics, and OS mitigations (ASLR, NX/DEP, stack canaries), with a Mermaid diagram of mitigations.

No commands, installs, credentials, or network access. Discusses exploitation concepts (return-address overwrite, heap metadata corruption, ROP, info leaks) only at a conceptual level; there are no exploit payloads, shellcode, malware, or evasion instructions, and no targeting of third-party systems.

Rated low rather than none because the topic is offensive-adjacent; the skill does not state an authorization scope, so users applying it to vulnerability research should confine it to binaries they own or are authorized to analyze.
